title: Cocontinuous and special cocontinuous functors between sites
statement: Let $\mathcal C$, $\mathcal D$ be sites (categories with a set of coverings $\operatorname{Cov}$, Stacks Sites Definition 00VH) and let continuous functors be as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (Sites Definition 00WV), and let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor. A family $\{W_i\to W\}_{i\in I}$ *refines* a family $\{W'_j\to W\}_{j\in J}$ with the same target if there are a map $\alpha:I\to J$ and morphisms $W_i\to W'_{\alpha(i)}$ over $W$, i.e. every $W_i\to W$ factors through some $W'_j\to W$ (Sites Definition 00VT(2)). (1) $u$ is *cocontinuous* if for every $U\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ and every covering $\{V_j\to u(U)\}_{j\in J}$ of $\mathcal D$ there is a covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ of $\mathcal C$ such that the family $\{u(U_i)\to u(U)\}_{i\in I}$ refines $\{V_j\to u(U)\}_{j\in J}$ (Stacks Sites, Definition 00XJ; the family $\{u(U_i)\to u(U)\}$ need not be a covering of $\mathcal D$). (2) $u$ is *special cocontinuous* if (a) $u$ is cocontinuous; (b) $u$ is continuous [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3); (c) for $a,b:U'\to U$ in $\mathcal C$ with $u(a)=u(b)$ there is a covering $\{f_i:U'_i\to U'\}_{i\in I}$ of $\mathcal C$ with $a\circ f_i=b\circ f_i$ for all $i$; (d) for $U',U\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ and a morphism $c:u(U')\to u(U)$ of $\mathcal D$ there are a covering $\{f_i:U'_i\to U'\}_{i\in I}$ of $\mathcal C$ and morphisms $c_i:U'_i\to U$ of $\mathcal C$ with $u(c_i)=c\circ u(f_i)$ for all $i$; (e) for every $V\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal D)$ there is a covering of $V$ in $\mathcal D$ of the form $\{u(U_i)\to V\}_{i\in I}$ with $U_i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$. These are the assumptions (1)-(5) of Stacks Sites, Lemma 03A0 (label lemma-equivalence), verbatim. Stacks' Definition 03CG (label definition-special-cocontinuous-functor) calls $u$ special cocontinuous when it satisfies the assumptions and the conclusion of Lemma 03A0 (the morphism of topoi $g:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ of the cocontinuous $u$, Sites Lemma 00XO, is an equivalence); here the definition consists of the conditions (a)-(e) only, and the conclusion is proved where a user needs it (see the remark in the proof field).

source.place: Definition Tag 00XJ (label definition-cocontinuous), Lemma Tag 03A0 (label lemma-equivalence) conditions (1)-(5), Definition Tag 03CG (label definition-special-cocontinuous-functor)

proof.text: *Remark: the definition is well formed and agrees with Stacks' 03CG.* Every clause is a condition on $u$ written with the coverings of $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ and, in (b), with continuity [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3) (whose fibre products $T\times_VV_i$ exist by the site axiom (iii) for the covering $\{V_i\to V\}$); no choice is made, so (2) is a property of $u$. A functor that is special cocontinuous in Stacks' sense (Definition 03CG: (1)-(5) of Lemma 03A0 and the conclusion that $g$ is an equivalence) satisfies (a)-(e), by dropping the conclusion. The converse is the content of Stacks Sites, Lemma 03A0: (1)-(5) imply that the adjunction maps $\mathcal G\to g_*g^{-1}\mathcal G$ and $g^{-1}g_*\mathcal F\to\mathcal F$ are isomorphisms. That direction is not part of this definition and no node of the DAG uses it through this node: the only user, [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos], proves the equivalence of topoi it needs for the inclusion $S_{affine,\Et}\to S_{\Et}$ directly (its steps 3-4, through Mathlib's AffineEtale.sheafEquiv and Equivalence.sheafCongr), so Lemma 03A0 is a pointer here, not a dependency.

mathlib_searches.verdict: not a Mathlib leaf. Translation for the Grothendieck topologies J, K generated by Cov_C, Cov_D (a sieve covers iff it contains a covering family): (a) is exactly Functor.IsCocontinuous J K (given a K-sieve S ⊇ {V_j}, the refining covering {U_i} lies in S.functorPullback u; conversely the pullback of the sieve generated by {V_j} contains a covering {U_i} whose images factor through the V_j); (b) is stronger than Functor.IsContinuous J K and not one Mathlib predicate; (c) and (d) are the J-forms Sieve.equalizer a b ∈ J U' and u.imageSieve c ∈ J U', which Mathlib has only as consequences of IsDenseSubsite (equalizer_mem :590, imageSieve_mem :585), while the classes IsLocallyFaithful/IsLocallyFull are the weaker K-forms (implied by (c),(d) with (b)); (e) implies Functor.IsCoverDense K (the covering {u(U_i)→V} lies in coverByImage); Stacks' form asks the covering itself to consist of maps from images, so for non-saturated Cov it is not literally the sieve condition. Conditions (a)-(e) imply Functor.IsCocontinuous J K ∧ Functor.IsDenseSubsite J K (functorPushforward_mem_iff: → by (b), ← by (a) with (c),(d) and local character), but that comparison is a theorem, not a one-line specialization (convention of stages/1-dag.md §2), so the node stays a definition node built from def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology
